_comment: Shared app catalog for JBTheatreTools. Both the macOS (SwiftUI) and Windows (WinForms) launchers bundle this file and resolve the per-OS/arch asset by exact name. Keep in sync with each tool's release asset names. Platform keys: macos, windows-x64, windows-arm64 (plus optional per-arch macOS keys macos-arm64 / macos-x64, which the macOS launcher prefers over the universal `macos` key when present). macOS assets are .zip bundles containing a .app; Windows assets are self-contained single-file .exe. The `self` object describes JBTheatreTools' own releases, used for the launcher's self-update check. `downloadServer` is the built-in relay base URL for the default passphrase auth mode (the endpoint requires the suite passphrase; a user-invisible override exists in local settings if this URL ever moves). Twenty-six apps (NETGEAR, MikroTik, Stagehand and Drive Atlas are shown only with the Development builds switch on until they have a release) (NDI Tools, PDF Tools, Image Tools and Surtitle Tools each ship two variants — a default and a batteries-included 'Full' — chosen by a per-row toggle; each app entry may carry an optional `variants` array [{id,label,assets}], and the Full variant uses the per-arch macOS keys macos-arm64 / macos-x64. Convert is date-tagged (build-YYYYMMDD, rolling) rather than semver, so it resolves against the latest release); Each app entry may carry optional `whatsNew` + `whatsNewVersion` strings (a one-line what's-new for its current release, shown under the app in both launchers; omitted for apps with no release yet). asset names must match each tool's release assets exactly (an app with no published release yet simply shows 'No release' until its first build ships). Each app entry also lists `dataFolders` (the folder names it keeps its own settings, logs and caches under: %APPDATA% and %LOCALAPPDATA% on Windows; Application Support, Logs and Caches in ~/Library on macOS) and `bundleIds` (macOS: its WebKit data, caches, saved window state and preferences), so uninstalling its last edition can offer to remove them. Check both against the app's own paths when it changes them. Optional per-app keys: `settingsBackup: false` marks an app with no settings Back up / Restore of the suite's kind (Back up all apps never starts it with --settings-*); `claudeSince` is the first release whose build is a Claude connector (`<app> --mcp`), so only installs at or past it are listed in connectors.json for Stagehand.

self.whatsNew: Back up every app's settings to one file and restore them on a new show computer; Stagehand joins the list.

apps.name: HELO Control
apps.blurb: Control AJA HELO stream / record encoders.
apps.whatsNew: Use it with Claude, back up and restore your settings, plain answers when the HELO can't be reached, and Stop and Saving… hold steady.

apps.name: Cisco Switch Tools
apps.blurb: Back up & manage Cisco CBS350 / SG switches over SSH.
apps.whatsNew: Test login for every switch, backups that include the running config, a real login every time, Claude, and settings backup.

apps.name: NETGEAR Switch Tools
apps.blurb: Back up, save, command and reboot a fleet of NETGEAR managed switches over SSH.
apps.whatsNew: First release: Test login, files named by the switch's System Name, an unsaved-changes diff, Claude and settings backup.

apps.name: MikroTik Router Tools
apps.blurb: Back up, snapshot, command and reboot a fleet of MikroTik RouterOS devices over SSH.
apps.whatsNew: First release: one Back up saves the export and a snapshot, Test login, fixes from a real RouterOS 7 router, Claude and settings backup.

apps.name: Cisco Brother Labels
apps.blurb: Generate Brother P-touch port labels from Cisco switch configs.
apps.whatsNew: Configs saved on Windows (Notepad, PowerShell) read correctly, drag and drop works on Windows, Claude and settings backup.

apps.name: Machine Inventory
apps.blurb: Collect hardware / software inventory from show machines.
apps.whatsNew: Snapshots save to Documents, not the app folder an update deletes; reports are never half-written; Claude and settings backup.

apps.name: Network Port Map
apps.blurb: Map network switch ports to the devices plugged into them.
apps.whatsNew: Router legs follow the router's own VLAN IDs, no switch silently dropped, safer Live capture, Claude and settings backup.

apps.name: Projector Control
apps.blurb: Control theatre projectors over PJLink (Panasonic / Epson).
apps.whatsNew: Freeze, Wake-on-LAN, groups, schedules, discovery and an Activity view; one Show lock shared with Claude; settings backup.

apps.name: Show Dashboard
apps.blurb: Generate a Node-RED show-control dashboard for a production.
apps.whatsNew: Deploy straight to Node-RED, a much fuller dashboard (alerts, event log, macros, schedules), Open… fixed, Claude and settings backup.

apps.name: Show Handbook
apps.blurb: Generate a per-show video handbook document.
apps.whatsNew: A Full edition for Windows with offline PDFs, a much faster first PDF, safer passwords, Claude and settings backup.

apps.name: PSN Tools
apps.blurb: Monitor, visualise, generate & record PosiStageNet (PSN) tracking data.
apps.whatsNew: The generator can't go silent any more, All interfaces really listens on every adapter, Claude and settings backup.

apps.name: DMX Tools
apps.blurb: Monitor, generate & translate Art-Net + sACN lighting data.
apps.whatsNew: Events and Capture views, more to generate, nothing stops silently, a blank box can't black out an output, Claude and settings backup.

apps.name: Desk Convert
apps.blurb: Convert digital mixing-console show files between manufacturers (DiGiCo ↔ Yamaha).
apps.whatsNew: Saving to a USB stick from a Mac works, Replace can't lose your earlier conversion, Claude and settings backup.

apps.name: NDI Tools
apps.blurb: Discover NDI video sources on the network and check their health & bandwidth.
apps.whatsNew: Full: real frame stats work on Windows. Dual-homed sources probe the right address. Claude and settings backup.

apps.name: PowerCalc
apps.blurb: Plan power distribution, balance the phases & print a load sheet.
apps.whatsNew: A clearer per-leg results table, exports that never lose an earlier load sheet, Claude and settings backup.

apps.name: Show Control Tools
apps.blurb: Monitor & translate OSC, MIDI and MSC show-control messages.
apps.whatsNew: A loopback listening option, a much sturdier Windows build, Clear opens on Cancel, Claude and settings backup.

apps.name: ShowNet Scanner
apps.blurb: Discover every device on a show network in one live inventory.
apps.whatsNew: CSV exports can't carry spreadsheet formulas, MAC and vendor are back for swept devices on Mac, Claude and settings backup.

apps.name: Timecode Tools
apps.blurb: Monitor, generate, convert & compare LTC, MTC and Art-Net timecode.
apps.whatsNew: Steadier MTC timing on Windows, LTC audio devices picked by name, Start opens on Cancel, Claude and settings backup.

apps.name: PDF Tools
apps.blurb: A private, offline PDF toolbox — merge, split, convert, redact and more.
apps.whatsNew: Big PDFs open fast, Reader links work again, Compress really shrinks scans, saves are safe, Claude and settings backup.

apps.name: Image Tools
apps.blurb: A private, offline image toolbox — convert, resize, watermark & scrub EXIF/GPS.
apps.whatsNew: Keep metadata off now really strips GPS and EXIF (HEIC, GIF, AVIF), rename is all-or-nothing, Claude and settings backup.

apps.name: Surtitle Tools
apps.blurb: An offline subtitle & surtitle toolbox — convert, retime, clean & check caption files.
apps.whatsNew: Saving works on Windows again, video saves to USB sticks from a Mac, a Windows Full edition, Claude and settings backup.

apps.name: Convert Tools
apps.blurb: Universal offline file converter — NOT a JB app: a repackage of the open-source p2r3/convert (GPL-2.0), all credit to its authors.

apps.name: Rename Tools
apps.blurb: Bulk-rename lots of files and folders at once with reusable rules.
apps.whatsNew: Renaming on USB sticks from a Mac works again, Enter can't rename by accident, Claude and settings backup.

apps.name: Repo Radar
apps.blurb: Every GitHub Actions run across your account in one live window.
apps.whatsNew: Ask Claude what's failing in your GitHub Actions; big accounts no longer freeze the window; settings backup.

apps.name: Stagehand
apps.blurb: Choose which of your apps Claude can use and what it may do in each, with show lock for the whole suite.
apps.whatsNew: First release: choose which apps Claude can use and what each may do, show lock for every app, and a log of what Claude did.

apps.name: Drive Atlas
apps.blurb: See what's filling your drives: a zoomable map of every folder, and safe clean-up to the Bin.
apps.whatsNew: First release: see what's filling a drive as a treemap or sunburst, find duplicates and what grew, and clear space safely to the Bin.
